Description.Details: Now, look, this here little module bolts onto any Projector Cannon and it's what we call a 'synergy-enhanced damage multiplier module.'  Runs a bit hot, but that's just 'aggressive performance thermodynamics' and your cooling handles it just fine, We're Sure!, probably. And if it gets hypothetically compromised? A 'thermal event.'' But hey, that's acceptable risk profiling for premium performance tiers. So, you wanna add one, or are you gonna keep running a stock cannon? 'Cause honestly, that's a little embarrassing.
